_: The message catalog: text meant for a PERSON, one key per message, read by msg_core.js (bim-compiler prompts/VOCAB_MESSAGE_CATALOG.md §3). Templates take {0} {1} … (legacy MessageFormat). English only, the keys of words_core.js and (P2b, §6) door.js: door.* is the text of the door's answers, read pinned to English so the envelope never changes (P2a; P3a adds the Student level labels, words.student.*, and the level setting); the bytes a person sees are the literals the code printed before (W-MSG-CATALOG M1). Never the envelope, the journal or verbs.json.
